annotations.title: List delivery attempts for an endpoint

description: List delivery attempts against one endpoint, newest first. Filter by status to find the failures. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/attempt/endpoint/{endpoint_id}.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id or uid.

endpoint_id.description: The endpoint's Svix id or uid.

iterator.description: Cursor from the previous page's `iterator` field. Omit for the first page.

status.description: Filter by attempt status: 0 success, 1 pending, 2 fail, 3 sending.

name: svix_list_attempts_by_endpoint
title: List delivery attempts for an endpoint
